summary: Completed Epic E2 (Voucher System) backend testing with 100% pass rate (50/50 tests). All voucher validation endpoints working correctly with proper SSOT pricing. Frontend voucher page renders correctly, but CRITICAL cart persistence bug blocks cart/checkout voucher testing.

backend_issues.notes: All backend endpoints working perfectly. Voucher validation API handles all scenarios correctly including adversarial payloads.

integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL: Cart items are cleared when navigating to /keranjang page. Add-to-cart works (cart drawer opens, localStorage saves item with 1 item), but when navigating to cart page, localStorage is overwritten with empty items array. This blocks all cart and checkout voucher testing.
reproduction_steps: 3. Verify localStorage 'cp:cart:v1' has items array with 1 item
5. BUG: localStorage 'cp:cart:v1' now has empty items array
6. Cart page shows 'Keranjang Anda masih kosong' empty state
integration_issues.evidence: localStorage before navigation: {"items":[{...1 item...}]}, after navigation: {"items":[]}
integration_issues.suspected_cause: CartContext useEffect race condition or HYDRATE action not working properly. The save() effect may be triggering before HYDRATE completes, overwriting localStorage with initial empty state.

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix cart persistence bug in CartContext. When navigating to /keranjang, the cart items are cleared from localStorage. The issue appears to be a race condition between the HYDRATE action (which loads from localStorage) and the save effect (which writes to localStorage). The save effect may be executing with the initial empty state before HYDRATE completes, overwriting the stored cart data. Suggested fix: Add a flag to prevent save() from running until after initial HYDRATE, or use a different approach to prevent the race condition. Once fixed, all cart and checkout voucher tests can proceed (voucher input, apply/remove, voucher center integration, checkout flow).
